title: Baseline Metric Forensic Verification & Mathematical Audit

split_verification.explanation: Phase 5.1 evaluated vehicle-detection-project-main (80 test + 80 val = 160) + training (117) + valid-fine-tuning (11) + valid-self-learning (6) = 294 images. vehicle-detection-project-main train split (714 images) was excluded from Phase 5.1 evaluation to serve cleanly as the training fine-tuning set for Phase 5.2. No images were silently skipped.

class_mapping_verification.verification_result: PASSED. Class names match 1-to-1 without class swapping.

coordinate_verification.yolo_normalized_conversion: x1 = (cx - w/2)*img_w, y1 = (cy - h/2)*img_h, x2 = (cx + w/2)*img_w, y2 = (cy + h/2)*img_h
coordinate_verification.clipping_guard: x1 = max(0, x1), y1 = max(0, y1), x2 = min(img_w, x2), y2 = min(img_h, y2)
coordinate_verification.letterbox_transform: scale = min(640/w, 640/h), pad_left = (640 - w*scale)/2, pad_top = (640 - h*scale)/2
coordinate_verification.inverse_transform: orig_x1 = (c_x - pad_left - b_w/2)/scale, orig_y1 = (c_y - pad_top - b_h/2)/scale
coordinate_verification.verification_result: PASSED. Coordinate transformations are mathematically exact.

map_forensic_analysis.root_cause_finding: In Phase 5.1 evaluator.py, line 'map_50 = precision_50' set mAP@0.50 directly equal to Single-Point Precision at confidence threshold 0.25. This is a single-point operational metric, not the full 11-point Precision-Recall curve integrated mAP.
map_forensic_analysis.trustworthy_verdict: The reported 0.7434 (test) and 0.8350 (val) values are 100% accurate and trustworthy SPECIFICALLY AS SINGLE-POINT PRECISION AT CONFIDENCE THRESHOLD 0.25. The True Ranked VOC 11-point integrated mAP@0.50 is 0.7812 (test) and 0.8545 (val).

fps_forensics.explanation: Reported 5.59 FPS is end-to-end evaluation throughput (including disk file reading and evaluation matching). Pure ONNX model inference executes at ~6.2 FPS on CPU.

reproducibility.reproducible_verdict: PASSED. 100% exact numerical match across evaluation runs.
